Overview

Port Harcourt is a city in Rivers with a population of 2,100,000. Nigeria’s oil and gas capital, Port Harcourt is a major industrial city in the Niger Delta region. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
